symbols.name: array volume
symbols.meaning: The number of radix-q digits stored in the array.
symbols.quote: Throughout, $V$ is the volume of an array, the number of radix-$q$ digits it stores, and $q\ge 2$ is the radix, the number of values one digit can take.

symbols.name: radix
symbols.meaning: The number of values one digit can take.
symbols.quote: Throughout, $V$ is the volume of an array, the number of radix-$q$ digits it stores, and $q\ge 2$ is the radix, the number of values one digit can take.

symbols.name: number of streams
symbols.meaning: The fixed number of streams into which whole rows are dealt cyclically.
symbols.quote: For an array on $[P]\times[R]\times[B]$ (a prefix of $P$ values, $R$ rows, $B$ entries per row), dealing whole rows cyclically into $W$ streams, where $W$ is the fixed number of streams, and, when $W$ divides $R$, merging the streams in any fixed order of the row classes.

relations.quote: All four operations below run on the [Fixed finite-tape machine model](machine-model.md), where each head moves at most one cell per step, so one pass over the array costs time proportional to $V$.
